'''West-3''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[human]] individual who served in the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Corporate Tactical Forces]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], West-3 participated in an [[ambush on Ferrix]] against [[Cassian Jeron Andor]]. West-3 and [[West-4]] were left in [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]]'s residence while the rest of the team moved on to assist [[East Team]] in apprehending Cassian.<ref name="Episode 3" />
